Miss Yonge begs to return her best thanks on behalf of [Bishop Patteson](/person/1155) to [Mr Fielder](/person/510) and his congregation for their Epiphany contribution to the [Melanesian Mission](/organisation/30)


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
